LeviLauncher needs access to all files to install and run Minecraft correctly. Without this permission, the launcher may not be able to install versions or save game data.
Please grant overlay permission, otherwise the log window cannot be displayed.

Android 11+ uses the FUSE filesystem for public external storage, which adds overhead when writing many small files and makes importing large packs noticeably slower.

Default directory (app-specific Android/data) bypasses FUSE and imports fast, but its data is removed when the launcher is uninstalled.

Custom directory lives on public storage, so data survives uninstall, but importing large packs will be noticeably slower.

string-array.item: Settings lets you adjust theme, color, background, and other appearance options to match your setup.
LeviLauncher is open source. Use GitHub issues to report launcher problems or suggest improvements.
Use the version dropdown to switch the current instance quickly.
You can drag mods to reorder their load priority.
Use Quick Launch to connect directly to a server without opening the game first.
You can import .mcworld, .mcpack, and .mcaddon files from the Content Management page.
Manage multiple Xbox accounts inside the launcher and switch between them seamlessly.
CurseForge lets you browse and download community content directly.
Import mods to extend or enhance Minecraft features and performance.
